title: forgemirror configuration
description: Configuration file of forgemirror (forgemirror.yaml). Every key can also be set via FORGEMIRROR_* environment variables, so keys such as webhook.secret are not required in the file.

listen_address.description: host:port of the webhook listener (POST /webhook); an empty host listens on all interfaces.

ops_listen_address.description: host:port of the ops listener (/healthz, /readyz, /metrics). Keep it cluster-internal.

read_header_timeout.description: How long a client may take to send the request headers.

shutdown_timeout.description: Upper bound for a graceful shutdown, including running mirrors. Keep it below the Kubernetes terminationGracePeriodSeconds.

state.description: Mandatory durable sync state, independent of the UI listener.

history_limit.description: Maximum retained sync attempts per repository.

history_retention.description: Maximum history age; must be positive. Pruned on writes and startup.

database.description: Required SQLite file. Defaults to data/state.db relative to the working directory. Empty paths are rejected; there is no in-memory fallback. Use a persistent local volume with one writer.

ui.description: Web UI for configuration, comparisons, history, explanations and publication controls. It has no authentication: put a reverse proxy or SSO in front of it.

enabled.description: Serve the web UI. When false, its port is not opened.

listen_address.description: host:port of the web UI listener.

log_entries.description: Number of recent log records kept in memory for the UI.

webhook.description: Webhook endpoint that receives Forgejo push events.

secret.description: Required (here, as secret_file, or via FORGEMIRROR_WEBHOOK__SECRET): the HMAC secret configured on the Forgejo webhook. Mutually exclusive with secret_file.

secret_file.description: File to read webhook.secret from, e.g. a mounted Kubernetes Secret. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Mutually exclusive with secret.

max_body_bytes.description: Maximum accepted request body size in bytes.

notifications.description: Optional generic outbound webhook with a durable transition-deduplicated outbox.

webhook_url.description: Secret HTTP(S) delivery URL; empty disables notifications.

webhook_url_file.description: File containing the secret delivery URL.

token.description: Optional bearer token; never reuse forge credentials.

token_file.description: File containing the delivery bearer token.

ui_url.description: Explicit public UI root URL for event links; empty omits links.

source.description: Credentials for cloning from Forgejo. Leave the token empty if only public repositories are mirrored.

base_url.description: URL of the Forgejo instance. Webhook payloads whose clone URL is not below it are rejected, so the token is only ever sent to this host. Empty accepts every clone URL.

username.description: Username sent together with the token.

token.description: Forgejo access token. Mutually exclusive with token_file.

token_file.description: File to read source.token from. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Mutually exclusive with token.

sync.description: What starts a mirror run: push webhooks, a schedule, or both, and whether runs apply automatically. A schedule and review mode need source.base_url and a source token.

first_publication_approval.description: Require ongoing source/destination authorization before publication. Requires UI; target/repository overrides take precedence. Existing unapproved mirrors also require approval.

auto.description: Apply runs started by pushes, the schedule and deletions. false enables review mode: those runs only compute what a sync would change, and publication needs an explicit UI authorization (sync, resume, approval or object-only LFS repair); authorized retry intent remains subject to current policy. false requires ui.enabled, source.base_url and a source token.

on_push.description: Forgejo push webhooks start runs (in review mode: refresh the diff). Setting this to false requires a schedule unless auto is false. webhook.secret is only required when this is true or a target sets delete.

schedule.description: Interval between scheduled runs over all repositories visible to the source token; 0s disables scheduled runs. The first run starts right after startup.

mirror.description: Git/LFS runtime settings and transfer bounds. Git LFS mirroring is automatic.

timeout.description: Per Git/LFS command timeout; also bounds each release/package transfer step.

max_concurrent.description: Maximum concurrent Git/LFS operations across all repositories. Forge API steps of typed targets are capped separately by the same number.

git_binary.description: Git executable: a name looked up in PATH or an absolute path. The official git-lfs CLI must also be on PATH.

work_dir.description: Directory for temporary clones and downloaded LFS objects; empty uses the OS temp directory.

filter.description: Which pushes are mirrored. Every configured rule must pass; without rules every push is mirrored. Patterns are Go regular expressions (RE2) that must match the whole value.

include_repos.description: Only repositories whose "owner/name" matches this pattern are mirrored.

exclude_repos.description: Repositories whose "owner/name" matches this pattern are never mirrored. Wins over include_repos.

include_branches.description: Only pushes to branches matching one of these patterns trigger a mirror. Tag pushes always do.

exclude_private.description: Skip repositories that are private on Forgejo. Only applies with untyped targets, no sync.schedule and automatic mode; otherwise private repositories are synced only if allow_private matches them.

allow_private.description: With any typed target, a sync.schedule or review mode, a private repository is synced only if this pattern matches its "owner/name", and exclude_private has no effect. With untyped targets, no schedule and automatic mode, matching private repositories pass exclude_private. Private repositories are created and kept private on every target.

require_topic.description: Opt-in: only repositories carrying this Forgejo topic are mirrored. Not an access control: every repository owner can set topics.

targets.description: Forges that receive the mirror. Without a type, target repositories must already exist.

first_publication_approval.description: Override global first-publication authorization policy for this target.

name.description: Unique name of the target, used in logs and metrics.

url.description: Push URL as a Go text/template, rendered per repository with {{ .Owner }}, {{ .Name }} and {{ .FullName }}. http(s) only, without credentials.

username.description: Username sent together with the token; GitHub, Codeberg and GitLab accept oauth2.

token.description: Access token for the target. Exactly one of token and token_file is required.

token_file.description: File to read the target token from. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Exactly one of token and token_file is required.

type.description: Forge API to use for this target. Without a type the target is a plain git push destination and the keys below are not allowed.

api_url.description: API base URL; derived from type and the host of url when empty (github.com uses https://api.github.com, other hosts <host>/api/v3 for GitHub, /api/v4 for GitLab, /api/v1 for Forgejo). Requires type.

create.description: Create the target repository when it is missing. Requires type.

delete.description: Permit deletion for an admitted deletion event or a fresh source lookup reporting not found. Review mode still requires application; pauses apply, first-publication grants do not. Listing absence alone never infers deletion. Requires type and a webhook secret.

prune_labels.description: Delete labels on the target that do not exist on the source. Deleting a label strips it from every issue and pull request, so this is off by default. Requires type.

prune_releases.description: Delete releases on the target whose tag has no published release on the source. Off by default. Requires type.

registry.description: Container registry of the target for package sync, as host[:port] or http(s)://host[:port]. Derived when empty: github.com uses ghcr.io, gitlab.com registry.gitlab.com, Forgejo the host of url; other hosts must set it when settings.packages is explicitly true, otherwise their packages are skipped with a warning. Requires type.

settings.description: Target-wide settings that win over the values of the Forgejo repository. Requires type.

overrides.description: Settings for matching repositories, applied in order on top of settings; later entries win. Requires type.

website.description: Repository website; ignored for GitLab, which has no such field.

default_branch.description: Default branch; applied after the first push, because the branch must exist.

private.description: Force the repository to be private on this target. Only true is allowed: a public source can be hidden, a private source can never be exposed.

has_pull_requests.description: Enable pull or merge requests; ignored for GitHub, which cannot disable them.

labels.description: Synchronise labels; false disables label sync for this scope. Defaults to true.

releases.description: Synchronise published releases (tag, title, notes, prerelease flag and attachments); drafts are never synced; false disables release sync for this scope. Defaults to true.

packages.description: Copy the container packages linked to the repository in Forgejo, with every tag, to the target's container registry. Only for public target repositories; tags are never deleted on the target; false disables package sync for this scope. Defaults to true.

mirror_url.description: Explicit public HTTP(S) contribution URL template, using repository fields. Appended to the mirror note and used as website when supported. Never inferred from the source; empty disables it.

mirror_description_limit.description: Description byte limit, default 350. Truncates only source text at a UTF-8 boundary, preserving the mirror marker and contribution URL.

mirror_note.description: Note appended to the description ("<description> · <note>") to mark the repository as a mirror. A Go text/template with {{ .Owner }}, {{ .Name }} and {{ .FullName }}; must render to a single line. An empty string disables the note. Defaults to "Mirror, synced by ForgeMirror. Do not push here.".
examples: Mirror of {{ .FullName }}, synced by ForgeMirror. Do not push here.

mirror_topic.description: Topic added to every repository to mark it as a mirror; always lower-cased, and kept even when topics is set. An empty string disables the topic. Defaults to "forgemirror".

first_publication_approval.description: Override first-publication authorization policy for matching repositories.

repos.description: Go regular expression (RE2) that must match the whole "owner/name" of the Forgejo repository.
